claims.claim: The CSS box model describes rectangular boxes with content, padding, border, and margin areas.
With content-box sizing, a declared width applies to the content box and horizontal padding and borders add to the outer width.
With border-box sizing, declared width includes content, padding, and border but not margin.
Margins create space outside an element's border and are not included by border-box sizing.
The box-sizing property chooses how the specified width and height are applied to an element's box.
